purpose: Audit whether a non-cherry-picked four-case holdout can be frozen after the budget-fix 6/6 mixed challenge result.

selection_rule.candidate_universe: Existing local ai2thor_live_gsam_* live_gsam_closed_loop.json rows only.
selection_rule.exclude_cases: All cases already used in selected positives, preregistered two-case reproduction, mixed challenge, waypoint rerun, and budgetfix rerun.
selection_rule.eligibility: Pickupable row with prior detector-stale evidence and prior detector-backed memory mutation, so the existing runner can plausibly reach the verify/update/task-bridge path without hand-picking after results.
selection_rule.ordering: Sort eligible cases by (scene, target, seed) and choose first four only if at least four eligible unseen cases exist.
selection_rule.stop_rule: If fewer than four eligible unseen cases exist, do not substitute hand-picked cases and do not run a holdout.

decision.reason: The fixed non-cherry-pick rule produced zero eligible unseen holdout cases. Running new hand-selected cases would weaken auditability and overstate scale.
next_valid_paths: Define and preregister a larger case-generation universe before any new run.
Add route/path-quality metrics on the existing fixed challenge instead of claiming broader scale.
Move to second-platform Habitat only with a separate preregistered perception-backed verify/update/task protocol.

what_results_support: There is no eligible unseen four-case holdout available under the current evidence-grounded local artifact universe and exclusion rule.
The correct next action under this rule is to stop before a new run rather than substitute hand-picked cases.
The budgetfix 6/6 result remains bounded to the fixed six-case mixed challenge.
what_results_do_not_support: No broad scale or statistical robustness claim.
No claim that the budgetfix transfers to unseen scenes, seeds, targets, or task families.
No claim that lack of eligible local holdout cases is evidence of general success.
claim_boundary: Holdout availability audit only: under a frozen evidence-grounded rule, there are zero eligible unseen local holdout cases, so no new holdout run is performed. This supports stopping/packaging the fixed-challenge budgetfix evidence, not broad scale or generalization.
